title: Kitten Yoga at SAFE HAVEN for Cats
description: Come for an hour of relaxing yoga as kittens frolic around the room. Your donation to participate goes towards SAFE Haven's no-K*ll mission.
long_description:
Come for an hour of relaxing yoga as kittens frolic around the room. Your donation to participate goes towards SAFE Haven's no-K*ll mission.

About this Event

Join us for yoga and kitten fun on Saturday, October 17th from 11:00-12:00 pm or 1:30-2:30 pm

Registered Yoga Teacher Kandice Scarberry will lead the class through a series of salutations and flows as kittens run around between the mats.

Your $35 ticket secures a spot for your yoga mat and will also go towards your adoption fee if you decide you can't live without one of the kitties you meet at the event (or on our adoption floor).*

Please bring your own yoga mat & towel. You will sign liability and media waivers upon entry to the event.

*pending approval
